hook_title.fr: Elle oublie 50 000 € dans un taxi… exprès

loop_note: Partie 1, coupée sur le visage de Prune juste avant la punition.

fr.title: Partie 1 : LA VALISE DE MADAME FIGUE 🧳
fr.description: Madame Figue oublie exprès 50 000 € dans le taxi de Kiwi pour tester son honnêteté. Kiwi, qui doit payer l'opération de sa petite sœur, rapporte tout… mais Prune, le neveu, garde la valise et l'accuse. Qu'aurais-tu fait à sa place ? Voix et images générées par IA.

cast.name: Madame Figue
cast.look: an elderly rich widow whose whole head is a large ripe deep-purple fig with a small curled stem on top and a few gentle wrinkles, mischievous brown eyes behind round gold glasses, a pearl necklace, a burgundy velvet coat with a brown fur collar, a black cane with a gold knob, small and elegant
cast.voice: a warm elderly female voice in her seventies, calm and mischievous

cast.name: Prune
cast.look: her nephew and butler, about 35, whose whole head is a glossy dark violet plum with a short brown stem, a thin black mustache, narrow scheming eyes and a fake smile, a black butler tailcoat, white shirt, grey waistcoat, white gloves, tall and thin
cast.voice: a sly honeyed male voice in his thirties that turns sharp

cast.name: Kiwi
cast.look: a 22-year-old taxi driver whose whole head is a round brown fuzzy kiwi fruit, tired green-gold eyes with dark circles, a shy kind expression, a worn grey hoodie under a faded navy denim jacket, a faded brown flat cap, brown trousers, slim
cast.voice: a soft trembling young male voice

cast.name: Groseille
cast.look: a 7-year-old girl whose whole head is a small shiny bright red redcurrant berry with a tiny green stem, huge sad eyes, pale, a light blue hospital gown with small hearts, holding a worn grey plush rabbit

lines.text: Cinquante mille euros. Je vais l'oublier dans un taxi… exprès.

scenes.visual_prompt: Madame Figue, mischievous smile, closes an open leather suitcase full of stacked euro banknotes on an antique gilded table, in the golden salon of a luxurious mansion at night, crackling fireplace, crystal chandelier; Prune stands beside her. Medium shot, warm golden light
scenes.motion_prompt: Madame Figue slowly closes the suitcase lid and pats it, the firelight flickers, slow push-in. Sound of a crackling fire.

lines.text: Ma tante, personne ne rend cinquante mille euros !

scenes.visual_prompt: Prune, eyebrows raised in disbelief, close-up in the golden salon, chandelier bokeh behind him
scenes.motion_prompt: Prune raises his eyebrows and spreads his gloved hands. Sound of the fire.

lines.text: Celui qui me la rapporte héritera de ma société.

scenes.visual_prompt: Madame Figue, sly and determined, strokes the leather suitcase with her hand, close-up, warm firelight on her gold glasses
scenes.motion_prompt: She taps the suitcase twice and smiles, slow push-in on her face. Sound of the fire.

lines.text: Encore une nuit… pour l'opération de Groseille.

scenes.visual_prompt: Kiwi, exhausted, at the wheel of an old yellow Paris taxi at night in heavy rain, a small photo of a little girl with a red berry head taped on the dashboard, cold blue street lights through the wet windshield, warm dashboard glow. Medium shot from the passenger seat
scenes.motion_prompt: Kiwi rubs his tired eyes, the wipers sweep the rain, slow push-in. Sound of heavy rain on the car roof.

scenes.visual_prompt: Madame Figue, knowing smile, steps out of the back of the yellow taxi in front of the lit Paris opera at night, leaving the leather suitcase on the back seat; Kiwi turns his head toward her from the driver's seat. Wide shot, rain, golden lights
scenes.motion_prompt: She closes the taxi door and walks away with her cane under an umbrella, the suitcase stays on the seat. Sound of rain and city traffic.

lines.text: Cinquante mille… L'opération en coûte trente.

scenes.visual_prompt: Kiwi, shocked, eyes wide open, opens the leather suitcase full of euro banknote bundles on the passenger seat of his taxi at night, rain streaming on the windows. Close-up
scenes.motion_prompt: Kiwi slowly lifts the lid, his eyes widen, the camera pushes in on his face. Sound of heavy rain.

scenes.visual_prompt: Groseille, pale and in pain, lies in a hospital bed with an IV drip, hugging her plush rabbit, a quiet hospital room at night, soft cold light from the window, warm bedside lamp. Close-up, dreamy memory
scenes.motion_prompt: Groseille turns her head slowly on the pillow, a tear on her cheek. Soft beep of a heart monitor.

lines.text: Non. Ce n'est pas à moi.

scenes.visual_prompt: Kiwi, tears in his eyes but determined, closes the suitcase in his taxi at night, rain on the windows. Medium close-up
scenes.motion_prompt: Kiwi shuts the suitcase, grips the steering wheel and starts the engine. Sound of rain and an engine starting.

lines.text: Bonsoir. Une dame a oublié ça dans mon taxi.

scenes.visual_prompt: Kiwi, soaked and honest, holds out the leather suitcase at the tall iron gate of a mansion at night in the rain; Prune, in a dark silk dressing gown, opens the gate. Medium shot, cold blue night, warm light from the mansion
scenes.motion_prompt: Kiwi lifts the suitcase toward Prune, rain drips from his cap. Sound of rain.

lines.text: Je la lui donnerai. Rentre chez toi, petit.

scenes.visual_prompt: Prune, fake smile, takes the suitcase from Kiwi at the mansion gate at night in the rain. Close-up on Prune
scenes.motion_prompt: Prune grabs the handle and gives a small dismissive wave. Sound of rain.

lines.text: Ma tante ne saura jamais que tu es venu.

scenes.visual_prompt: Prune, greedy grin, alone in a dark marble entrance hall, opens the suitcase full of euro banknotes on the floor, the front door closed behind him. Low angle, candle light
scenes.motion_prompt: Prune runs his gloved fingers over the banknotes and laughs silently. Quiet hall, a clock ticking.

lines.text: Personne n'est venu, ma tante. Il a tout gardé.

scenes.visual_prompt: Madame Figue, disappointed, eyes closed, sits in a velvet armchair in her study in the morning light; Prune stands next to her with a falsely sad face. Medium shot
scenes.motion_prompt: Madame Figue lowers her head slowly, Prune hides a smile. Quiet morning, birds outside.

scenes.visual_prompt: Kiwi, in despair, is pressed against the hood of his yellow taxi by two French police officers whose heads are big striped watermelons, in dark blue uniforms, at a taxi rank on a grey Paris street; Prune points at him with a smug smile. Wide shot, overcast daylight
scenes.motion_prompt: The officers hold Kiwi down, Prune points and shouts, passers-by stop. Street noise, a police siren far away.

lines.text: Je l'ai rendue ! À vous ! Hier soir !

scenes.visual_prompt: Kiwi, desperate and crying, his cheek against the yellow hood of his taxi, his cap fallen on the ground. Close-up
scenes.motion_prompt: Kiwi struggles and cries out, tears on his fuzzy face. Street noise.

lines.text: Le traceur de ma valise dit autre chose…

scenes.visual_prompt: Madame Figue, suspicious, gets out of a black luxury car at the taxi rank and looks at her phone showing a map with a blinking red dot. Medium shot, grey daylight
scenes.motion_prompt: She lowers her gold glasses and stares at the phone, then looks up slowly. Street noise.

lines.text: Prune… Pourquoi elle dort dans ta chambre ?

scenes.visual_prompt: Prune, terrified, turns pale as Madame Figue shows him her phone screen with a red dot on a map; the street behind them. Extreme close-up on Prune's face
scenes.motion_prompt: Prune's smile freezes and he starts sweating, slow push-in on his face. The street noise fades.
